# Evaluation & Acceptance Requirements Quality Checklist: 通用域评测与多域验收（011）

**Purpose**: 评审 011 Feature 在评测集质量、硬指标三件套、多域端到端、全集回归、文档债核销、前端中英文切换与交叉引用受益再验证七个面的需求质量（完整性/清晰性/一致性/可度量性/覆盖度），作为 requirements 的"单元测试"。
**Created**: 2026-09-07
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) | [plan.md](../plan.md) | [research.md](../research.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## 1. 评测集质量（查询-证据对应人工审核、固定集纪律、中文覆盖）

- [x] CHK001 - Are the per-query human-review record fields (review_status / review_notes / grounded_source) specified as mandatory before a query is admitted to the dataset? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005/§FR-007]
- [x] CHK002 - Is the "LLM 生成 + 人工审核入库" method specified with a concrete review step and an explicit rejection path for queries failing review? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005]
- [x] CHK003 - Is the Chinese-coverage requirement quantified with a specific per-domain minimum (≥2 条)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005]
- [x] CHK004 - Is the format-coverage requirement (markdown/txt/html/csv 每格式 ≥2 条, ≥1 自然语言 + ≥1 结构定位) explicitly specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006]
- [x] CHK005 - Is the legal-domain subset split (条文结构 ≥4 + 交叉引用受益 ≥6, is_structural_benefit 标记) specified unambiguously? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006]
- [x] CHK006 - Is the fixed-set discipline (独立文件、不追加进 eval_dataset.json、结构锚点) specified to prevent breaking existing entries? [Consistency, Spec §FR-007]
- [x] CHK007 - Is the cross-environment-stable expectation anchor (expected_heading, 不依赖运行时 ID) specified? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007/SC-010]
- [x] CHK008 - Is the query-answer correspondence precondition (每条查询锚定到语料内真实可定位 Chunk) specified as an admission gate? [Coverage, Spec §FR-007]
- [x] CHK009 - Is the immutability-after-admission rule (字段只增不改不删) specified for future evolution of the datasets? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007/FR-026]

## 2. 硬指标三件套全量验证（串库=0 / Schema 100% / 定位 100%）

- [x] CHK010 - Are the three hard metrics each specified with objective pass/fail thresholds (泄漏=0, Schema 合法率=100%, 定位率=100%)? [Measurability, Spec §FR-023~FR-025]
- [x] CHK011 - Is the mixed-domain acceptance suite specified as the measurement carrier for all three metrics? [Completeness, Spec §FR-014]
- [x] CHK012 - Is the leakage criterion specified to cover both single-domain (不返回他域证据) and multi-domain (证据归属正确) scenarios? [Coverage, Spec §FR-023]
- [x] CHK013 - Is locatability specified to include converter-format (txt/html/csv) 与 word/pdf 定位前缀（标题路径 / page:N §编号）? [Coverage, Spec §FR-025]
- [x] CHK014 - Is the measurement record (逐条/逐证据实测) specified to persist as a distinct acceptance artifact? [Completeness, Spec §FR-014]

## 3. 多域端到端验收（domain_scope/slug 寻址、list_knowledge_domains、双形态冒烟）

- [x] CHK015 - Are the three domain_scope addressing forms (数字 scope ID / slug / type:name) all specified for acceptance coverage? [Coverage, Spec §FR-012]
- [x] CHK016 - Is the list_knowledge_domains discovery flow specified as the entry point（发现 → 寻址 → 检索 → 展开闭环）? [Completeness, Spec §FR-013]
- [x] CHK017 - Is the four-scenario reference discipline (仅 project_scope / 仅 domain_scope / 双参数混用 / 皆空拒绝) specified with rejection semantics? [Coverage, Spec §FR-022]
- [x] CHK018 - Are the writer/reader 双形态冒烟 requirements specified with 单侧非回归判定语义? [Completeness, Spec §FR-015/SC-006]
- [x] CHK019 - Is the reference-client policy (DeepSeek Harness 必过、ChatGPT/Claude 记录不阻塞) specified? [Clarity, Spec §FR-015]
- [x] CHK020 - Are the ≥4 语义轴 scope（personal/generic/legal/se-project）required for the acceptance environment? [Coverage, Spec §FR-012]

## 4. 既有全集回归（各报告按各自口径重跑）

- [x] CHK021 - Are the six regression calibers (001 Dense 11 / 002 混合 18 / 003 格式集 37 / 004 图集 37 / 005 agentic 63 / 006 冒烟 11×2) each specified per feature? [Completeness, Spec §FR-016]

- [x] CHK023 - Is the no-overwrite discipline (重跑产物落 011 前缀新文件) specified for regression artifacts? [Consistency, Spec §FR-016]

- [x] CHK026 - Are the three doc-debt items (roadmap 至 2.0 状态 / README 纠正 / spec Status 更新) each specified with concrete targets? [Completeness, Spec §FR-018~FR-020]
- [x] CHK027 - Is the "不超售/如实陈述" constraint specified for README updates? [Clarity, Spec §FR-019]

- [x] CHK030 - Is the eval/README 登记 requirement（数据集/报告/运行器/重跑口径）specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-018]

## 6. 前端中英文切换（仅前端，后端零改动）

- [x] CHK031 - Is the toggle scope (仅前端自产文案) specified with explicit exclusions（后端错误消息/领域数据原样）? [Clarity, Spec §FR-029]
- [x] CHK032 - Is the persistence + 默认英文 + 存量零破坏 requirement specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-027]

- [x] CHK035 - Is the backend/MCP 零变更 constraint specified for i18n? [Consistency, Spec §FR-031]

## 7. 交叉引用受益再验证（Q1=A 双分支闸口）

- [x] CHK036 - Is the benefit gate (MRR 与 nDCG 均值相对提升 ≥3% + Recall 非降 + 硬指标全过) specified with both branches（达标启用 legal 词表 / 未达标维持 R11）? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011/SC-007]

- [x] CHK038 - Are the 非约束性锚点 semantics（无 enters_default_path、无最低水位门槛）consistent across spec/plan/research? [Consistency, Spec §FR-010 / research R5]
- [x] CHK039 - Is the domain-profile seed change (personal 新增 + legal 扩展) specified as 声明式配置变更（非代码路径硬编码）? [Consistency, Spec §FR-001/FR-003]
